nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Guidance document for Claude Code explaining that FixUp Arena is a single static index.html landing page with no build step, describing its view-switching, 3D background, and scroll-animation architecture, and directing questions to the graphify knowledge graph first.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: The entire FixUp Arena marketing/landing page — a single static HTML file combining Tailwind-styled markup for four faux 'views' (home, privacy, terms, support), a Three.js particle background, GSAP/ScrollTrigger scroll animations, and vanilla JS hash-based client-side navigation, with Stripe Payment Links for registration.

nodes.name: navigateTo
nodes.summary: Hash-based client-side view navigation function that switches between the faux home/privacy/terms/support views.

nodes.name: tick
nodes.summary: Animation loop tick function driving the Three.js particle background render loop.

layers.description: The single-page marketing site itself — index.html's Tailwind markup, Three.js particle background, GSAP/ScrollTrigger animations, and hash-based view navigation for the FixUp Arena landing page.

layers.name: Documentation
layers.description: Project guidance for AI assistants describing the site's no-build, single-file architecture and pointing to the graphify knowledge graph for deeper questions.
